assumptions.touchdown_pose: settled on the crawler (layout D, dyn_model.static_unilateral), pads stick at first touch
assumptions.tangential_compliance: rod lateral (perpendicular to the leg axis) k_t = series(swivel cantilever, concrete); 'yaml' = L1 kt_per_pad (upper bound), 'ext' = secant k_t(e) (best estimate)
assumptions.rod_check_criterion: SF_rod_yield >= 1.5 with (secant k_t, C45 305 MPa) and (YAML k_t, 20MnV6 450 MPa), same pair as the D8 provisional limit decision (leg_rod_lateral_check.md 1.3)
assumptions.quasi_static: no dynamic overshoot (levelling dynamic max is +1.6 kN over the end value, 3.10.5)
assumptions.no_reanchoring: values are levelling-end values without the H4 re-anchoring action

meta.conventions: body x fwd, y left, z up; target R = Ry(theta) Rx(phi) (ZYX, yaw free); roll > 0 left up, pitch > 0 nose down; floor slope (phi_g, theta_g) = plane z = -tan(theta_g) x + tan(phi_g) y (attitude on the crawler); forces kN, strokes m (motor coordinate)

rules.note: relative diamond |phi_t-phi_g|/Phi + |theta_t-theta_g|/Theta(sign) <= 1 and optional absolute diamond |phi_t|/Phi_a + |theta_t|/Theta_a <= 1; grid 0.25 deg
